'''Septimont''' is a [[Region]] and city-state of [[Rinascita]]. Unlike [[Ragunna]], Septimont has a far more militant and irreligious culture, as it places far less importance on the primacy of the [[Sentinel]] [[Imperator]] and instead worships the [[Lioness of Glory]] Arsinosa. As a result, the Agons, competitive gladiatorial combat, are the pinnacle of Septimontese society and can even determine the makeup of the political establishment. The [[Order of the Deep]] holds little power in Septimont, with most locals uninterested or even hostile to their message of salvation.

Septimont can be reached during {{Quest|Shadow of Glory}}.

==Government==
Septimont is lead by the Ephor, head of the city. The Priestess can foretell fate and can that makes the final calls and acts alongside the Ephor. Most people trust her judgement. They are accompanied by a [[Council of Elders]] who advises the Ephor but ultimately, the decision-making comes down to them. The Ephor's word is law as the rule of Septimont is those who have Power stands at the top. The current Ephor is [[Augusta]] and the current Priestess is [[Iuno]], who is considered extreme in the line of Priestesses. Not everyone agrees with her behavior despite her capabilities.<ref>Main Quest: [[Shadow of Glory]]</ref>

==Trivia==
*Aside from succession via {{w|Might makes right|gladitorial kratocracy}}, Septimont's system of government somewhat resembles that of ancient {{w|Sparta}}, with the Ephor and Priestess of Septimont advised by a Council of Elders bearing similarities to the {{w|List of kings of Sparta|Two Kings of Sparta}} who are in turn advised, ironically, by five individuals holding the title of {{w|Ephor}}, though the Elders are more akin to the {{w|Gerousia}}. Though, unlike the Spartan Ephors and Gerousia, the Septimont Council of Elders have no judicial authority over the Ephor and Priestess.
===Etymology===
*Septimont is derived from Latin ''septem montes'', meaning “seven mountains” or “seven hills.” The name references Rome, traditionally known as the city of the Seven Hills.
